verdict: The 4.764209x figure is a valid, narrow M216 H67-FC2 K1-to-K8 always-ready standalone-frontend result; it is not an M307 Conv result and cannot be attached to M321. M218 supplies executable service-only RTL and a fixed-latency premodel, but the connected M216-to-M218 frozen-trace cycle result still does not exist. M304 is a separate FC1/Conv adapter predesign fork, not closure of the FC2 4.764x chain. For Conv, M307 reports 1.644554x WIDE144 or 1.292379x SHARED96 versus bit sparse and only 1.067506x or 1.048245x over tau0 exact. Its matcher, packer and DMA terms are represented but all 17,280 selected phases bind on compute; metadata, physical banking and commit are not executable. More importantly, M321 cannot implement M307's PWP-plus-residual nonsnap path: when out_snapped is false it returns the original pattern instead of the nearest center, affecting at least 5,161,708 selected assignment rows. Therefore M321/M329 does not close M307 today. Keep both branches separate and build two small module-level cycle executors rather than a global scheduler.

denominator_identity.scope: 120 frozen H67 ep35 FC2 records, 5,580,000 tokens, 143,894,510 nonzero events

numerator.name: M216 matched K1 always-ready standalone frontend

denominator.name: M216 matched K8 always-ready standalone frontend

m216_logic_only_ablation.boundary: scope-matched frontend logic only; ideal clock, ZeroWireload and zero macro

primary_fixed_model.warning: This interval assumes the fixed-latency in-order service recurrence and endpoint overlap extremes. It is not a guaranteed bound after real SRAM arbitration, finite buffers or commit.

m304_scope_break.role: Read-only predesign that reuses the protocol shell for binary FC1 and binary Conv destination-major G4 service
m304_scope_break.unresolved_port_requirement: Four independent G4 lanes need four source addresses per modulo-8 bank per cycle; M218 has one read per bank.

minimum_executable_module_sim.scope: M216 frontend plus FIFO4 plus M218 tagged slice service plus finite eight-bank weight memory plus Acc24 context plus commit, replayed on the same 120 FC2 records
cycle_kernel: Drive the exact raw4/header/payload/done trace into matched K1 and K8 M216 frontends.
Advance ready/valid one cycle at a time; never substitute max(frontend_total, service_total) for connected backpressure.
Expand each accepted group into six 16-lane slices per output block, arbitrate one declared request per bank/port and enqueue tagged responses with fixed or traced latency.
Model FIFO4, O8, response skid, context ownership, same-cycle reuse, result drain and authoritative token done exactly as RTL.
Count frontend stall, request issue, bank conflict, response wait, context hazard, result, BN2/residual and final commit cycles separately.
Miter accepted group/request/response/context-write/result/done counts and output identity against the bit-exact K1 reference.
minimum_executable_module_sim.baseline_policy: Primary A/B keeps memory banks, queues, context capacity and commit matched and varies only K1 versus K8 source issue cap; native-cropped K1 is a separately labeled area/energy sensitivity.
minimum_executable_module_sim.promotion_gate: The measured connected cycle ratio must replace both the 4.764209 frontend-only number and the 4.214619-to-5.785795 analytic interval for any complete-FC2 module claim.

denominator_identity.scope: Ten samples of zurich_city_09_a, four PAFT ep4 running-BN bottleneck Conv layers, 17,280 operator-partition phases and 51,840,000 16-bit partition vectors

work_and_existing_cycle_accounting.interpretation: M307 does not literally omit abstract matcher, packer or full PWP DMA. It charges matcher_rows+16, ceil(assignment_rows/8)+4 and a 960-cycle next-partition DMA, then hides all of them behind candidate compute with a max() and perfect double buffering.

m321_m329_mapping.m321_semantics: One 16-bit row is compared combinationally against sixteen 16-bit centers, followed by a two-stage elastic tournament; popcount is internal.
m321_m329_mapping.per_phase_service_convention: For N accepted rows, use N+2 component cycles to preserve M251's N+pipeline_cycles accounting convention. Exact edge-to-edge drain is N+1; this one-cycle-per-phase convention difference must be predeclared.
m321_m329_mapping.one_shared_matcher_is_sufficient_only_if: M307's phases remain globally sequential, one 256-bit center bundle is resident for the current partition, upstream/downstream sustain II1, and no partition is interleaved.

m329_logic_only.scope: TSMC28 pre-layout ideal-clock ZeroWireload logic only; RTL-to-mapped Formality passed

m321_m329_mapping.center_delivery: M321 consumes in_centers_flat[255:0] on every accepted transaction but does not contain the center SRAM. A wrapper may load 32 bytes once per sequential partition into a held register, but that load, register/broadcast network and bank timing are outside M329.

semantic_interface_blocker.m307_required_behavior: For pwp_nonsnap rows, when 1+nearest_distance is less than population but nearest_distance exceeds tau, use the nearest center's PWP and explicitly execute the residual correction.
semantic_interface_blocker.m321_observed_behavior: out_selected_pattern is the nearest center only when out_snapped is true; otherwise it is set to out_original_pattern. M321 also emits no center index.
semantic_interface_blocker.derivation: 11,242,524 selected assignments minus at most 3,295,740 exact-center hits minus 2,785,076 positive-distance snapped rows
semantic_interface_blocker.impact: The downstream cannot address the nearest PWP or form the residual for at least this population without rematching. M321/M329 therefore cannot be substituted for M307's abstract matcher today.
semantic_interface_blocker.minimum_fix: Emit unconditional best_center and a tie-consistent center_index through the elastic pipeline, retain original pattern, and derive residual_mask=original XOR best_center. Keep snapped as a separate correction-elision policy bit. Reorder or tag the PWP table consistently with the minimum-packed-center tie break.

free_or_idealized_cost_audit.detail: matcher_rows+16 is a one-row-per-cycle abstraction; M321 can provide q16 II1/latency2 only after the semantic output fix and center delivery closure.

M307 sends only 14,709,294 population-at-least-two rows to the matcher instead of 51,840,000 raw rows. M321 computes popcount internally but still consumes an input slot for every row unless a separate prefilter/compactor exists.
The 32-byte center bundle per partition, center index, table ordering, metadata SRAM ports and broadcast timing are absent.
M251/M307 loads all 18,432 PWP bytes per phase at 32 bytes/cycle and double-buffers them, but has no executable SRAM/DRAM bank or prefetch schedule.
WIDE144 assumes one 144-byte PWP vector per cycle while retaining one 96-byte weight vector per cycle; SHARED96 serializes PWP to two cycles. Neither has bank conflict, macro latency or area.
ceil(assignments/8)+4 is included, but FIFO occupancy, row crossing, metadata write and backpressure are absent.
Final output write, bias/scale/BN/neuron and commit traffic are absent from both numerator and denominator. Common costs reduce any speedup toward one.

M307 matches abstract compute service rates, not cell/macro area. The candidate-only 1,997.982-um2 M329 matcher plus center/PWP/metadata storage is not charged or exchanged for equal baseline resources.

cycle_sensitivity_not_admission.warning: The serialized rows are deliberately simple stress screens, not guaranteed lower bounds. Unmodeled bank conflicts, finite FIFOs or commit can be worse; current evidence establishes no positive executable-cycle lower bound.

minimum_phi_style_executable_module_sim.scope: One q16 pattern engine plus PWP prefetch/pack/compute/commit pipeline for the four isolated Conv layers; no global accelerator scheduler required.
pipeline: K-first raw-row reader and optional explicit population prefilter/compactor
M321-fixed q16 matcher with latency2, II1 and downstream backpressure
finite match FIFO carrying row/partition/center-index identity
pattern-index-directed PWP prefetch from a declared banked table
eight-unit cross-row assignment packer with finite queue
PWP/correction compute service using WIDE144 and SHARED96 as separate physical candidates
neuron/bias/scale/commit stage and output SRAM port
minimum_phi_style_executable_module_sim.cycle_rule: Simulate every ready/valid edge and dependency. Load the next partition's centers/PWP only through declared ports. Permit matcher, prefetch, compute and neuron overlap only when their finite queues and independent ports actually allow it; record startup, drain and every stall cause.
minimum_phi_style_executable_module_sim.baseline_fairness: Replay dense, bit-sparse, tau0 and tau1011 through the same memory ports, output commit and clock. Report cycle speedup, area overhead, throughput/mm2 and energy only after adding the M329 logic and all SRAM/macro costs.

m321_scaling_options: Time-multiplex one q16 matcher for q/16 passes: q128 effective row II is at least 8 plus cross-pass minimum reduction.
Replicate q/16 matchers: q128 uses eight M329 logic blocks, about 15,983.856 um2 pre-layout logic before global reduction, center SRAM and a 2,048-bit aggregate center interface.
Build a true q-entry one-dimensional systolic matcher with one row/cycle after q-cycle fill, then synthesize and model its banked center supply independently; M329 numbers do not transfer.
q_extension_dse.required_next_evidence: Rerun q8/16/32/64/128 on the same PAFT-ep4 train-only catalog and selected tau policy, then capture tile-local center/PWP working-set reuse and pattern-index prefetch traces. Near-global heldout entry use prevents assuming that the full catalog can be pruned.

findings.title: The 4.764209x denominator belongs to FC2 M216, not Conv M307
findings.evidence: M216 divides 429,716,335 matched K1 frontend cycles by 90,196,785 matched K8 frontend cycles on 120 H67 FC2 records. M307 contains no 4.76 result; its selected points are 1.644554x WIDE144 and 1.292379x SHARED96 versus bit sparse.
findings.impact: Connecting M321 to a 4.764x numerator would combine unrelated operators, traces, cycle recurrences and baselines and invalidate a headline.
findings.required_fix: Keep an explicit metric namespace: FC2.frontend.K1_to_K8, FC2.connected.K1_to_K8, Conv.PAFT_vs_bit_sparse and Conv.tau1011_vs_tau0. Never move a ratio across namespaces.

findings.title: M321 does not expose the nearest center required by M307's nonsnapped PWP-plus-residual path
findings.evidence: M307 uses a PWP when 1+distance is below population even if distance exceeds tau. M321 instead assigns out_selected_pattern=out_original_pattern whenever out_snapped is false and emits no center index. At least 5,161,708 selected assignment rows require the missing behavior.
findings.impact: The current RTL cannot reproduce M307 candidate work or address the correct PWP without a second match. M321/M329 therefore cannot close M307's executable interface.
findings.required_fix: Pipeline unconditional best_center and center_index, preserve original_pattern, output residual_mask and verify tau1011 PWP/correction conservation against the frozen trace before integrating cycles.

findings.title: M216 and M218 remain disconnected for performance
findings.evidence: M216 is always-ready frontend replay; M218 is service-only RTL/VCS/DC plus a fixed-latency recurrence. There is no connected frozen-trace ready/valid cycle replay.
findings.required_fix: Build the minimal connected module executor with FIFO4, O8, finite memory responses, contexts and commit and replay matched K1/K8.

findings.title: M304 is a protocol-reuse fork, not closure of the FC2 4.764x chain
findings.evidence: M304 targets destination-major G4 FC1/Conv, carries unresolved four-read-per-bank G4x4 memory, and admits no RTL or cycles. Its strongest-baseline task-only upper is 1.4787x FC1 or 1.5878x Conv over M218-like K8.
findings.required_fix: Report M304 in a separate FC1/Conv table and implement single-G4 calibration plus a bank-port DSE before any G4x4 claim.

findings.title: M307's max-overlap recurrence is not an executable dependency schedule
findings.evidence: All 17,280 selected phases bind on compute, so matcher, packer and next-DMA cycles never increase total time. Finite queues, startup/drain, partition switching and downstream backpressure are absent.
findings.required_fix: Replace the per-phase max with the proposed ready/valid K-first module simulator and publish stall-cause counters.

findings.title: Raw-row compaction and center/PWP metadata supply are not implemented
findings.evidence: M307 charges only 14.709M matcher rows from 51.840M raw rows. M321 internally computes population but consumes a slot per offered row. Center loads, center index, metadata SRAM and table ordering are absent.
findings.required_fix: Either feed all raw rows and charge them, or implement and price an upstream popcount filter/compactor; add a held center register and indexed metadata interface.

findings.title: The WIDE144 and SHARED96 ports are rates, not banked memory implementations
findings.evidence: The model streams 530.842 MB of candidate weight/PWP data over the ten-sample trace and hides 960 DMA cycles per phase. It has no SRAM bank conflict, macro latency, address trace or pattern-index prefetch proof.
findings.required_fix: Generate tile-local address traces and model finite center/PWP/weight banks and prefetch queues for each port candidate.

findings.title: M307 is not area-matched after adding M329 and memories
findings.evidence: M329 adds 1,997.982 um2 of logic for one q16 matcher, while center, PWP, metadata and buffer macros remain zero. The bit-sparse baseline receives no equal-area alternative resource.
findings.required_fix: Report cycle speedup and area overhead separately, then provide area-normalized throughput with the same macro inventory or give the baseline equal area for extra lanes.

findings.title: q128 is a memory-and-matcher architecture change, not a free DSE knob
findings.evidence: The older M70 k16/q128 screen reaches 1.947818x vector work but uses 220,683 of 221,184 entries and a 384.75-MiB signed19 full catalog; even a signed12 sensitivity is about 243 MiB. One M321 would require eight passes per row.
findings.required_fix: Keep q extension separate, rerun it on M307's exact cohort, and collect tile-local working-set/prefetch traces before choosing time multiplexing, replication or a systolic matcher.

findings.title: M321 latency accounting has a one-cycle convention ambiguity
findings.evidence: Latency2/II1 gives N+1 edge-to-edge drain but M251's component convention is N+pipeline_cycles, yielding N+2.
findings.required_fix: Freeze one convention in the simulator and assert it against a directed N=1,2,burst cycle trace.

findings.title: Accuracy and population coverage remain narrow
findings.evidence: M307 passes only paired S10 with AEE delta +0.014362 on one sequence; valid825 is false. M216 covers one H67 sequence.
findings.required_fix: Retain all cohort qualifiers and add cross-sequence/event-density strata plus valid825 before a paper headline.

findings.title: Common commit costs are missing from both speedup branches
findings.evidence: FC2 still lacks BN2/residual/final commit in the connected path; Conv lacks bias/scale/neuron/output commit. Common work shrinks ratios toward one even when it cancels functionally.
findings.required_fix: Make commit bytes, port, latency and overlap explicit in both matched baselines.

P0: Fence the 4.764209 FC2 numerator from every Conv/M307 claim.
Repair the M321 output contract to carry unconditional best center/index and residual information, then add a frozen-trace semantic miter.
P1: Build the M216-to-M218 connected FC2 cycle executor; this is the shortest route to a credible 4x-class module claim.
Build the q16 Conv K-first matcher/PWP/packer/compute/commit executor with finite ports; use WIDE144 and SHARED96 as separate points.
Only after q16 closes, run the q8-to-q128 same-cohort working-set and matcher-area DSE.
P2: Add valid825 and cross-sequence strata, explicit drain convention and common commit accounting.

claim_boundary: Read-only audit and minimum module-level cycle-simulator predesign. No source, RTL, contract, production analyzer or docs/359 was modified; no EDA or HDL tool was run. All 4.764209x, 4.214619-to-5.785795, 1.644554x, 1.292379x, 1.067506x, q-extension and stress-screen figures retain their exact operator, trace, baseline and modeling qualifiers.
